interaction_target: find, understand, plan distribution for, and connect an external internet thing without collapsing its standing
borrowed: The interaction grammar is a bounded Find / Understand / Distribute / Connect workspace. The material is this estate's own source-contract, SourceFrontier, ItemArchive, Matrix and foreign-edge projections; it does not borrow a foreign product's data or authority.
shape: three persistent stages — source workset, exact release inspection, and portable distribution proposal — with a fourth relationship/claim standing read beside the proposal
refusal_states: refused (401/403) — the native observe owner refuses; the page does not substitute a browser fetch
empty (200, no contracts) — an empty source-contract projection
failed (other) — no source rows or destination state are invented
unbound public program — source admission and ItemArchive depth are shown as real but do not masquerade as delivery
actions: observing one more public source, performed by the estate's own ForeignTwin owner. Destination selection only creates a browser-local, downloadable proposal; it submits no activation, price, purchase, claim, or account-link effect.
forbidden_inference: a source contract, SourceFrontier admission, or ItemArchive item -> a public-program binding or route
a selected economic destination -> a price quote, purchase authority, payment, settlement, or funding commitment
a source field naming place -> a spatially valid local projection
a browser-local distribution plan -> a native activation or authority grant
a promoted or claimed twin -> ownership, verified control, or external account access
an observed edge -> a connection to that host
requires_authority: observing carries the `self` session scope; every release, frontier, archive and relation read answers without one. A proposal is locally held and demands no authority because it is explicitly not an effect.

lineage.note: The catalogue is a bounded source-release projection rather than the 135k-row receipt directory, so public discovery is not a bulk forensic export. Exact receipts remain separately queryable. The source stage is ForeignTwin, source admission is SourceFrontier, retained material is ItemArchive, and no missing public-program owner is fabricated.
